scope: Clarify the existing exact-key source OOV rule for the declared codec grid; no candidates, codebooks, fitting rows or quality gates change
source_rule: Local head ID zero is the fixed all-zero feature for unseen canonical n-grams
deployment_rule: The actual model adapter forces local ID zero outputs to FP32 positive zero after any codec lookup. Apply this identically to raw, native, FAISS, code dedup and native-code compositions
stored_row_rule: All original stored-row bytes are independently decoded and hashed before model masking. Approximate encodings may change physical row values, including never-addressed padding; original IDs and physical domains remain fixed. FP32 lossless packing preserves every source row byte
quality_reuse: Require identical complete stored decoded-row hashes, the same zero-sentinel deployment rule, unchanged nonrow/base weights, batch schedule and actual full-model request hashes
independent_controls: Separately trained head constants have no key registry or OOV distinction; the parameter-matched hidden adapter has no n-gram addressing. These are different trained-model controls, not source-preserving codecs
